description: Election Commission - H. M. D. Kumara was Selected as the Member of the Anamaduwa P.S., R. I. B. Rathnamalala was Selected as the Member of the Anamaduwa P.S. R. A. D. Fernanado was Selected as the Member of the Chilaw P.S.
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha and Chilaw Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by party membership cessation, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
